features.before: Resizing the browser could leave the game view at its boot size and overlay handles out of alignment.
features.after: The live game view grows or shrinks with the browser, every overlay handle stays on its element, and the engine reports both virtual console size and true backing-store pixels.
features.value: The editing-size readout and the HUD stay aligned with the picture on screen.

features.before: The editor had no Pause or Resume control, so lining up the HUD meant waiting for a useful demo frame.
features.after: Pause and Resume sit beside the demo selector and follow the engine's real state, including console changes and an honest disabled reason on unsupported backends.
features.value: You can stop on a quiet frame and adjust the HUD without losing the moment you wanted.
